caption: The drawing depicts a single candlestick holder centrally positioned on a plain background. The candlestick holder features a round, shallow base that gradually curves upward into a slender stem, which supports a cylindrical socket for holding a candle. The object is composed using shades of black and gray pencil, creating the appearance of shadows and highlights that give the object a three-dimensional form. The composition is simple, with the candlestick holder occupying the center of the rectangular drawing area, surrounded by empty space, and a thin border is drawn near the edges of the paper. In the bottom right corner, the name "JANET RIZA" is written in capital letters. The background is off-white with slight discoloration near the top edge.
title: Candlestick
